req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates GET /players/{playerId} returns HTTP 200 with the matching Player object. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — retrieve a known player by UUID and assert all fields exactly; (2) NEG negative — request a well-formed UUID that does not exist, expect HTTP 404; (3) BVA boundary — use the first (squad 1) and last (squad 26) seeded players' UUIDs to probe boundary rows; (4) NEG negative — supply a malformed non-UUID path segment, expect HTTP 422; (5) DT decision-table — verify the response body field-by-field against the seeded data to catch field-mapping mutations; (6) EP positive — verify a player with optional fields populated (middle_name, starting11=true) returns those fields correctly. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient, exact-value assertions, and only fields that exist in PlayerResponseModel/Player schema.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_returns_200_and_exact_fields
expected: Response body matches all fields of the seeded player with squadNumber=10
trace: R-PLAYER-002: system shall respond with HTTP 200 and matching Player object
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_returns_200_and_exact_fields():
    player_id = 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Mary'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'DM'
    assert body['team'] == 'River Plate'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == False

tests.name: test_get_player_response_contains_no_extra_unexpected_keys
expected: Response JSON keys are exactly the PlayerResponseModel fields in camelCase
trace: R-PLAYER-002: EP — response schema conformance; catches field-addition or field-removal mutations
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_response_contains_no_extra_unexpected_keys():
    player_id = '2b515093-76be-4c72-98de-729c368f7ddb'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    expected_keys = {
        'id', 'firstName', 'middleName', 'lastName', 'dateOfBirth',
        'squadNumber', 'position', 'abbrPosition', 'team', 'league', 'starting11'
    }
    assert set(body.keys()) == expected_keys
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 5
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Vivaan'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Nair'
    assert body['starting11'] == False

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_after_create_returns_new_player
actions: POST /players/ to create a new player with squadNumber=99
Extract the id from the Location header or response body
expected: GET returns HTTP 200 with the newly created player's fields
trace: R-PLAYER-002: STC — state transition: player created then retrieved by UUID
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_after_create_returns_new_player():
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Test', 'lastName': 'Player', 'squadNumber': 99,
        'position': 'Goalkeeper', 'starting11': False
    }
    post_r = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    created = post_r.json()
    new_id = created['id']
    get_r = client.get(f'/players/{new_id}')
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    body = get_r.json()
    assert body['id'] == new_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Test'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Player'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 99
    assert body['position'] == 'Goalkeeper'
    assert body['starting11'] == False
